proven: npc_textblock quest flows retain executable status
strongly_correlated: key items linked by decoded quest operation or exact exit qualifier are active only through the owning quest/exit
research_only: simulator condition clues and unlinked key candidates cannot create quest state
fallback: preserve evidence; never infer offer, stage, reward, consumption, or completion from item existence alone
save_world_state_impact: prevents false quest flags and accidental item consumption
